verdict.rationale: Databricks documents its own background automation primitives: deployable ETL pipelines, Auto Loader processing new files as they arrive, SQL alerts that deliver notifications automatically, and an Agent Runtime with durable execution that survives restarts. However, the evidence never explicitly documents recurring schedules or triggers for these automations, and the Genie Code 'autonomous agent' is an interactive, approval-gated workspace assistant rather than a background runner. missing for 10: documented recurring scheduling/triggers for jobs or agents, explicit evidence of autonomous agent runs operating unattended in the background, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Monitor query results, evaluate conditions, and deliver notifications automatically.
Incrementally and efficiently process new data files as they arrive in cloud storage.
AgentKit adds durable execution so that runs survive restarts and crashes.
Create and deploy an ETL (extract, transform, and load) pipeline for data orchestration using Lakeflow pipelines and Auto Loader.
